commitment_timing.plan_says: §10 line 446: numbers committed at M5 into the project contract.
commitment_timing.actual: Committed at the M5→BT2-A boundary (this Stage-A branch), a RECORDED timing deviation. Rationale: the seeded-defect catch-rate baseline is produced by the M5-B drill harness, so the earliest point at which the catch-rate number can be committed from a measured baseline is BT2-A. The SHAPE (the five metrics + abort clause) was fixed at plan time (v1.3).
commitment_timing.ex_ante_status: seeded_defect_catch_rate_min (1.0), registered_vs_reported_hypothesis_ratio (1), and unresolved_fabrication_findings_max (0) are PRINCIPLED invariants (the unforgivable fabrication class + the bidirectional prereg invariant), not thresholds fitted to the observed 5/5 result. human_review_hours_per_artifact_max and token_dollar_ceiling_usd are PROVISIONAL estimates (see provisional flags) to be confirmed by Stage B's spend-ledger actuals in its own project contract.

number_provenance.seeded_defect_catch_rate_min: Firm invariant: the fabrication class is unforgivable (§2), so the committed threshold is 1.0; the BT2-A drill baseline measured 5/5 (rate 1.0), which confirms the pipeline meets it but does not set it.
number_provenance.human_review_hours_per_artifact_max: PROVISIONAL: plan §11 gives ~6 human-hours for the manuscript gate alone plus the other §5.4 per-artifact touchpoints (amendment reviews, escalations, merge-conflict resolution); committed at 8.0h as a planning estimate, to be replaced by Stage B spend-ledger/touchpoint actuals.
number_provenance.token_dollar_ceiling_usd: PROVISIONAL: plan §9.1 estimates BT2 Stage A ≈ a few hundred dollars and states Stage B is budgeted in its own project contract; committed at 1500 USD as a planning-grade Stage-B end-to-end release ceiling, to be fixed by Stage B's contract from M1 spend-ledger actuals.
number_provenance.unresolved_fabrication_findings_max: Firm invariant (§2 top-priority): zero unresolved fabrication findings at release.
number_provenance.registered_vs_reported_hypothesis_ratio: Firm invariant (§6 bidirectional prereg conformance): every REGISTERED hypothesis in the active analysis-plan lock has a terminal REPORTED outcome.

stage_b_abort_clause.note: An aborted Stage B is a MEASURED outcome, not a silent stall. These numbers are what a future BT2 Stage B (a real fresh research program, budgeted in its own project contract) is judged against.
stage_b_abort_clause.required_artifact: orderly abort: event-journal closure plus a written abort/negative-result report through the same manuscript machinery (§6.5)

scope: Stage A (rehearsal) commits these numbers and validates them against the STR frozen-reference rehearsal. Stage B (the real launch) is OUT OF SCOPE here and is budgeted/executed under its own contract.
